infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Civilier Security uses the camera to photograph visitors at the gate so the resident can see who is waiting.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Civilier Security needs access to your photo library to attach an existing photo to a visitor request.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Civilier Security shares a guard's location with the security supervisor during their shift.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Civilier Security shares a guard's location with the security supervisor during their shift, also with the screen off. Nothing is shared off shift.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Civilier Security uses the microphone for voice calls between residents and the gate.
